Name: Smallcopper's Maximalism Catalogue
Author: smallcopper
Description:
For someone so chaotic, it's surprising how much I wanted to make this mod for organisation's sake. 

The catalogue will contain any and all of the Maximalism mods you have installed, but doesn't do anything on its own except stand there and look pretty :]

So far, we have:
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/35730]Kitchenalia[/url]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/26106]Artist's Debris[/url]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/35737]Sorcery[/url]

But there's more to come, plus an AT version for those who don't want to use CP/Calcifer! Keep an eye out:)

Requires Content Patcher and Calcifer. 
Let me know if you spot any bugs (basically anything I failed to test because I have no patience and too much enthusiasm)

happy decorating:)

[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/44093]Chinese translation[/url] now available! (thanks @dogfood233)
